title: Preprocessor and Professional C
goal: Macros, header guards, multi-file build, Makefile, argc/argv, GDB aur sanitizers.
definition: Preprocessor compile se pehle text transformations karta hai: includes, macros, conditional compilation. Professional C me headers, build automation aur diagnostics ka discipline isi par khada hai.
explain: #define PI 3.14159 object-like macro; #define SQ(x) ((x)*(x)) function-like macro — arguments ko brackets me rakho warna precedence bug. Macro me side effects (SQ(i++)) se bacho.
Header guards (#ifndef X_H / #define / #endif) ya #pragma once double inclusion se bachate hain. Declarations header me, definitions .c me.
Conditional compilation: #ifdef DEBUG, #if, #elif, #else, #endif. Build flags se logging on/off karo.
Command line arguments: int main(int argc, char *argv[]) — argv[0] program name, argc count. atoi/strtol se numbers, validation karo.
GDB: break, run, next, step, print, bt. Sanitizers: -fsanitize=address,undefined. Makefile: targets, dependencies, tabs.
analogy: Preprocessor ek copy editor hai jo compile se pehle text badalta hai; compiler asli grammar baad me dekhta hai. Isliye macro errors weird dikhte hain.
why: Professional projects multi-file hote hain; headers, build flags aur debugger ke bina 10k-line code maintain nahi hota. Interviews me macro pitfalls aur build process poochha jaata hai.

syntax.code:
#ifndef UTIL_H
#define UTIL_H
int add(int a, int b);
#endif
syntax.note: Header guard double inclusion rokta hai.

syntax.code:
#define MAX(a,b) ((a) > (b) ? (a) : (b))
#define ARRAY_LEN(a) (sizeof (a) / sizeof (a)[0])
#ifdef DEBUG
#  define LOG(...) fprintf(stderr, __VA_ARGS__)
#else
#  define LOG(...) ((void)0)
#endif
syntax.note: Brackets aur __VA_ARGS__ macro ke core tricks.

topics.title: Macros aur pitfalls
topics.body: Object-like vs function-like. Brackets, multiple evaluation, semicolon. Inline functions often better. #undef se macro hatao.

topics.title: Headers aur multi-file
topics.body: Declarations .h me, definitions .c me. Include guards. extern globals. static file-private functions. Compile: gcc *.c -Iinclude -o app.

topics.title: Conditional compilation
topics.body: #ifdef DEBUG, #if VERSION >= 2, #elif, #else, #endif. Platform-specific code. __FILE__, __LINE__, __func__ diagnostic macros.

topics.title: Build, argv, tools
topics.body: Makefile target/deps/recipe. argc/argv parsing + validation. GDB breakpoints, backtrace. ASan/UBSan flags. -O2, -g, -Wall -Wextra -Werror.

interview.a: Macro text replace karta hai (type-agnostic, no scope, double evaluation risk); inline function type-checked hai aur debugger me dikhta hai. Default inline lo, macro sirf token pasting/#if ke liye.
Optimized binary debug symbols ke saath build hota hai; par optimized variables 'optimized out' ho sakte hain, isliye debugging ke liye -O0/-Og better.
interview.followUp: Release strip? — strip binary se symbols hataata hai.
